comments: Weight-decay experiment on top of the best result so far (single-frame finetune, 0.3684 val dice, peak epoch 216/300, then a genuine overfitting signature -- val loss/dice degrade through epoch 300 while train loss stays flat). weight_decay=1e-4 added via kurals/learners/model.py's new AdamW optimizer (previously plain Adam with no decay at all, anywhere in this codebase's history -- a real, previously-untried regularization lever, chosen over Adam's coupled decay per Loshchilov & Hutter 2019). Conservative value (same order of magnitude as lr) given this task's pattern so far: aggressive interventions on this fragile a signal (noise augmentation, CFAR contrast normalization) have consistently backfired. Same architecture/init/lr/schedule/no extra augmentation otherwise, so weight_decay is the isolated variable against kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_finetune.json.
